correct_answer: Neither is currently valid as a golden record. Per VMP-001, the golden record requires both current tax ID AND active qualification status in one record. The tax ID is in S/4 and qualification is in Ariba. These must be merged first, creating a single consolidated record before any PO extension.
rationale: VMP-001 section 6.1 is explicit: the golden record must contain BOTH the current tax ID AND active qualification status. Currently, the tax ID (34-2918756) lives in S/4 vendor 300042 while the qualification (audit date 2025-09-12, approved) lives in the Ariba profile. Neither record alone satisfies the policy requirement. The vendor's email confirms the entity converted from LLC to Inc. in January 2026 with the same tax ID, which means the S/4 name is stale. The correct action is to merge the records — update S/4 vendor 300042 with the 'Inc.' name, ensure the Ariba qualification is linked, and only then designate the merged record as golden and extend the BPO. Answer D ignores that the qualification status is not in the S/4 record. Answer B gets the logic partially right but incorrectly calls the Ariba profile the golden record when it lacks the tax ID — the policy requires both attributes in one record. Answer D violates VMP-001 by issuing a PO against the Ariba profile which is not the designated golden record and does not contain payment/tax configuration needed for PO processing in SAP.
